o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آتا (ata), from Proto-Turkic *ata. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐱃𐰀 (t¹a /⁠ata⁠/).
Borrowed from Arabic دِينِيّ (dīniyy). By surface analysis, din + -i.
From phonological nativization of müjdəlik, from müjdə + -lik.
